entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: Cenn of Kinsbaile, the largest kithkin clachan on Lorwyn; an eloquent but bumbling politician.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: The largest kithkin clachan on Lorwyn, later called Kinscaer.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: Kinsbaile's heroine and archer, Teeg's right hand.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: A yew treefolk sage hosted by Teeg who hired Ashling to reunite him with Rhys.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin messenger hired by Colfenor.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf elf outlawed from his tribe after his magic backfired; former pupil of Colfenor.

entities.name: Taercenn Nath
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf commander who pursued Rhys and laid siege to Kinsbaile.

entities.name: Donal Alloway
entities.description: Cenn of Kinsbaile (Kinscaer) after the Aurora.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: An elf tribe that outlawed Rhys and whose soldiers besieged Kinsbaile.

entities.name: Festival of Tales
entities.description: Annual festival at Kinsbaile in 4520 AR.

entities.name: Aurora
entities.description: The event after which Kinsbaile became Kinscaer.

events.summary: During the Festival of Tales, Teeg hosts Colfenor, whose presence draws many others to Kinsbaile.
events.quote: He hosted the yew treefolk sage Colfenor

events.summary: Colfenor hires Ashling through Teeg to reunite him with Rhys.
events.quote: Through Teeg, Colfenor hired the flamekin messenger Ashling

events.summary: Nath arrives and lays siege to Kinsbaile; Teeg welcomes him openly and Kinsbaile falls immediately.
events.quote: Kinsbaile fell immediately as Teeg welcomed Nath openly

events.summary: Rhys narrowly evades Nath by leaving the clachan on a task for Colfenor; Nath and Gryffid wait for his return and begin subjugating Kinsbaile.
events.quote: Rhys had unintentionally managed to narrowly evade Nath by leaving the clachan to perform a task given to him by Colfenor.

events.summary: Teeg orders Brigid to bring Rhys back subdued to win Nath's favor, but Colfenor alters the message so Brigid targets Ashling, foiling the plot.
events.quote: However, Colfenor modified the message bound for Brigid and had her target Ashling instead

events.summary: Rhys returns, fights his former tribesmen, kills Nath and drives the elves out of the clachan.
events.quote: In the end, he emerged victorious, killing Nath and threatening the rest of the elves out of the clachan.

events.summary: Teeg dies in the conflagration Colfenor causes by using Ashling's patron elemental to end his own life.
events.quote: Teeg perished in the conflagration caused by Colfenor

events.summary: After the Aurora, Donal Alloway becomes cenn of Kinsbaile, now called Kinscaer.
events.quote: After the Aurora, the position of the cenn of Kinsbaile
